# tiny-chess-01
> UCI chess engine in Python 3.13 stdlib (<4 KB) for make.fun tiny-chess-01 ($500 USDC).

- Entry: `main.py` (3,780 bytes)
- Python: 3.13 (`os`, `sys`, `json`, `urllib.request`)
- Board: 10x12 rotated mailbox (180° flip)
- Search: MTD-bi Negascout + Quiescence + NMP + LMR
- Eval: Procedural PeSTO distance + King endgame
- Budget: 8,000 nodes/move (deterministic, zero clocks)
- Repo: https://github.com/Akash1070/tiny-chess-01.git
